TIYANKI_ARMOR_DESC: The hide of the Tiyanki Matriarch has been hardened by the years and unknown biological processes.
space_amoeba_desc: Space Amoeba are lone predators, aggressive towards anything they encounter. Supported by partially-formed spawn known as "flagella", these creatures are adept at chasing down their prey.
RED_EYE_BEAM_DESC: The lens of a creature's eyes are enhanced to project high-intensity red laser beams. Further modification of the genome triggers the spontaneous growth of additional eyes.
sponsored_colonizer_desc: Private Colony Ships are funded by unknown actors from the private sector. As a result the colonists may have ethics differing from the majority.
RED_LASER_DESC: Laser weapons fire focused beams of light at targets, causing damage through the generation of intense heat.
BLUE_LASER_DESC: More powerful than red lasers, these blue variants emit electromagnetic radiation at a wavelength that appears blue or violet to most organics.
UV_LASER_DESC: Ultraviolet lasers are an updated and more powerful version of their blue predecessors. Accurate and destructive, these weapons are capable of inflicting great damage.
XRAY_LASER_DESC: These lasers have a shorter wavelength than UV-based laser weaponry, but are even more destructive.
GAMMA_LASER_DESC: The electromagnetic radiation emitted by gamma lasers is of an extremely high frequency. Their destructive potential is unmatched in the field of laser weapons.
ENERGY_LANCE_1_DESC: These heavy energy weapons fire focused particle beams that cause massive damage.
ENERGY_LANCE_2_DESC: A more powerful version of the particle lance, this weapon fires a tachyon beam of immense power.
PERDITION_BEAM_DESC: A massive array of linked energy amplification conduits that fires a beam of unprecedented firepower.
PLASMA_1_DESC: Weapons that eject destructive balls of high-energy plasma at targets. These plasma projectiles are extremely effective at eating through ship armor and hull.
PLASMA_2_DESC: These new accelerators launch projectiles of high-energy plasma with improved containment fields. This results in less energy leakage as the projectile travels in space towards its target.
PLASMA_3_DESC: The latest in plasma weaponry, these cannons are fully militarized versions of the older, somewhat improvised plasma throwers. Their plasma projectiles are even deadlier.
ARC_EMITTER_1_DESC: Powerful weapons that launch a lightning arc of chaotic energy at a target, bypassing shields and armor.
ARC_EMITTER_2_DESC: These upgraded emitters are equipped with better focusing lenses, resulting in a more powerful energy discharge.
DISRUPTOR_1_DESC: Disruptors fire high-energy bolts that weaken and destroy the molecular bonds that hold the target's constituent atoms together.
DISRUPTOR_2_DESC: These upgraded disruptors fire bolts of more destructive ion particles at targets, without sacrificing the firing rate of their predecessors.
DISRUPTOR_3_DESC: Extremely high-yield disruptors that fire quantum energy charges causing incredible damage to those unfortunate enough to get in their way.
ENERGY_TORPEDO_1_DESC: These energy projectiles consist of tightly concentrated protons capable of causing immense damage to the hull of enemy ships.
ENERGY_TORPEDO_2_DESC: Upgraded energy projectiles that rely on neutrons instead of protons for their destructive power.
MINING_DRONE_LASER_1_DESC: Focused mining lasers cut through ship hulls as easily as they carve rocky asteroids.
BLUE_CRYSTAL_WEAPON_1_DESC: The Blue Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Sapphire-class Crystalline Entities to inflict damage.
GREEN_CRYSTAL_WEAPON_1_DESC: The Green Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Emerald-class Crystalline Entities to inflict middling damage.
YELLOW_CRYSTAL_WEAPON_1_DESC: The Yellow Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Topaz-class Crystalline Entities to inflict good damage.
RED_CRYSTAL_WEAPON_1_DESC: The Red Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Ruby-class Crystalline Entities to inflict considerable damage.
SPACE_CLOUD_WEAPON_1_DESC: Utilizing our understanding of the fundamental forces involved in generating the Void Clouds' considerable internal charge to the fullest, the Cloud Lightning weapon system is a potent damage-dealer.
EXTRADIMENSIONAL_1_DESC: Hailing from another dimension, the core technologies of the Matter Disintegrator bends several physical laws for destructive results.
MISSILE_1_DESC: Space-to-space missiles equipped with high-yield nuclear warheads. Although based on old pre-space technology, these crude fire-and-forget weapons can be surprisingly effective at range.
MISSILE_2_DESC: These updated space-to-space missiles have more powerful fusion warheads and improved flight performance.
MISSILE_3_DESC: Advanced missiles equipped with very powerful antimatter warheads. A new and improved guidance system gives them a better chance of finding their targets.
MISSILE_4_DESC: The latest version of space-to-space missile, this upgraded variant has an immensely powerful warhead that draws its energy from a zero point vacuum.
MISSILE_5_DESC: These highly advanced missiles are equipped with limited onboard AI pilots that substantially improve their performance and ability to track targets.
SWARMER_MISSILE_1_DESC: These smaller missiles are launched in volleys and have been specifically designed to overwhelm enemy point-defense systems.
SWARMER_MISSILE_2_DESC: New miniaturization techniques will allow us to equip swarmer missiles with more powerful warheads and improved flight performance.
SCOURGE_MISSILE_1_DESC: The Scourge Missile payloads are made up of many of the biochemical compounds used by the Swarm in interstellar combat, having proven unexpectedly effective against even the hardiest of military vessels.
MEDIUM_SCOURGE_PROJECTILE_WEAPON_DESC: Enclosed in ballistic capsules, the highly corrosive organic matter used in the Swarm's orbital bombardment can be repurposed as ship munitions.
SMALL_SCOURGE_PROJECTILE_WEAPON_DESC: Enclosed in ballistic capsules, the highly corrosive organic matter used in the Swarm's orbital bombardment can be repurposed as ship munitions.
SWARM_STRIKE_CRAFT_1_DESC: Cloned, miniaturized Prethoryn specimen can be controlled through wavelengths close to those we use for intra-fleet communication, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.
AMOEBA_STRIKE_CRAFT_1_DESC: Amoebas bred in captivity spawn Flagella that can be imprinted to respond to subtle shifts in hull magnetization, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.
TORPEDO_1_DESC: These torpedoes are essentially very large, slow-moving missiles. They are equipped with more powerful warheads and shield modulators that let them slip unmolested through energy screens.
TORPEDO_2_DESC: Upgraded space torpedoes encased in armor, to better withstand enemy point-defense fire. The armor fragments into shards that cause additional damage when the torpedo detonates.
TORPEDO_3_DESC: Advanced torpedoes with very powerful warheads. They have a sleeker design, faster engines and upgraded shield modulators for slipping through energy screens.
MASS_DRIVER_1_DESC: These electromagnetic projectile launchers use magnets to accelerate armor-piercing rounds towards targets at high speeds.
MASS_DRIVER_2_DESC: Coilguns are more powerful versions of the early mass drivers, using electromagnetic coils to rapidly accelerate projectiles towards targets.
MASS_DRIVER_3_DESC: Railguns use twin parallel rails to fire projectiles at incredible speeds.
MASS_DRIVER_4_DESC: A new version of the venerable railgun, with sturdier rails and an upgraded power supply. These weapons are even more powerful and accurate than their predecessors.
MASS_DRIVER_5_DESC: This updated version of the old coilgun design is even more destructive than the latest railgun designs. It is capable of launching projectiles with incredible accuracy and speed.
KINETIC_ARTILLERY_1_DESC: Very long-range artillery capable of hurling powerful rounds over extreme distances with a large degree of accuracy.
KINETIC_ARTILLERY_2_DESC: An even more powerful long-range, ship-based artillery cannon, equipped with a new barrel and an upgraded fire control computer.
MASS_ACCELERATOR_1_DESC: An enormous variant of kinetic artillery, so large that it has to be placed in a fixed spinal mount.
MASS_ACCELERATOR_2_DESC: An even more powerful variant of spinal-mounted kinetic artillery.
AUTOCANNON_1_DESC: Large-caliber ballistic weapons that fire cased explosive shells. The main advantage of these cannons is their high rate of fire.
AUTOCANNON_2_DESC: These upgraded rotary autocannons feature improved tracking and fire control systems. This allows them to maintain an even higher rate of fire.
AUTOCANNON_3_DESC: Advanced rotary autocannons capable of spewing a cloud of high-explosive shells at a target.
FLAK_BATTERY_1_DESC: Gun batteries that fire shrapnel rounds at close range. They are particularly lethal to enemy strike craft, but can also defend against missiles.
FLAK_BATTERY_2_DESC: Upgraded flak batteries with new, more powerful shrapnel rounds.
FLAK_BATTERY_3_DESC: Predictive tracking algorithms and even more powerful rounds make these batteries incredibly lethal to enemy strike craft.
EMPTY_DRIVE_DESC: Ships without FTL drives will never be able to leave the solar systems in which they were built.
HYPER_DRIVE_1_DESC: Ships equipped with Hyper Drives travel swiftly between the edges of star systems along interstellar hyperlanes.
HYPER_DRIVE_2_DESC: Ships equipped with Hyper Drives travel swiftly between the edges of star systems along interstellar hyperlanes.
HYPER_DRIVE_3_DESC: Ships equipped with Hyper Drives travel swiftly between the edges of star systems along interstellar hyperlanes.
JUMP_DRIVE_1_DESC: The Jump Drive tears ship-sized holes in the very fabric of reality, allowing for near-instantaneous movement between systems. The nature of the space the ship passes through on this journey is still poorly understood.
PSI_JUMP_DRIVE_1_DESC: The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psionic potential of the ship's crew to warp the local space-time continuum, eliminating the distance between the point of origin and the destination. Supposedly.
EMPTY_FTL_INHIBITOR_DESC: Starbases without an FTL Inhibitor will not be able to halt enemy ships.
ftl_components_DESC: Any ship traveling to another system requires an FTL drive of some sort.
sensor_components_desc: Sensors will reveal the details of any systems and fleets within their range.
thruster_components_DESC: Thrusters are used for sub-FTL propulsion, and is a vital component for all ships.
ship_aura_components_DESC: Ships of this class be equipped with field emitters that project and maintain localized fields that induce various effects in enemy or friendly vessels.
power_core_DESC: Few things work without power, and the power core is a vital part of any machine.
SENSOR_1_DESC: A planet-bound technology adapted for use in deep space, the radar system provides basic detection and tracking capability for interstellar vessels.
SENSOR_2_DESC: These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
SENSOR_3_DESC: Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.
SENSOR_4_DESC: Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
AFTERBURNER_1_DESC: Afterburners provide additional combat speed for the ship.
AFTERBURNER_2_DESC: These improved afterburners provide even more combat speed for the ship.
SHIELD_1_DESC: Energy deflector screens can stop a limited amount of incoming enemy fire before overloading. Their main drawback is that they consume large amounts of power.
SHIELD_2_DESC: These updated deflector screens are capable of soaking up even more punishment before they overload.
SHIELD_3_DESC: These new shield generators represent the next generation of energy screens, replacing the older deflector technology. They offer significantly better protection.
SHIELD_4_DESC: An updated shield generator that produces an even stronger energy field. Only sustained enemy fire can penetrate this barrier.
SHIELD_5_DESC: These reinforced and hardened energy shields are incredibly powerful. The protection they offer is second to none.
SHIELD_BOOSTER_DESC: These capacitors store surplus energy which can quickly be transferred to reinforce a ship's shields.
REACTOR_BOOSTER_1_DESC: Additional power generation systems increase the ship's reactor output.
REACTOR_BOOSTER_2_DESC: The discovery of fusion power allows for better reactor boosters to be fitted onto our ships.
REACTOR_BOOSTER_3_DESC: The discovery of antimatter power allows for highly advanced reactor boosters that can greatly enhance ship reactors.
FIRE_CONTROL_1_DESC: By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.
AUTO_REPAIR_DESC: These bacteria are imprinted with the ship's structural design and will attempt to restore hull integrity should it be compromised.
PSI_SHIELD_DESC: These extremely powerful shields are generated out of pure psionic energy by a cadre of psionic specialists. Their powers are further augmented by large arrays of psi emitters.
ARMOR_1_DESC: Reinforced nanocomposite hull plating can provide an extra layer of protection that could be the difference between life and death in a combat situation.
ARMOR_2_DESC: A combination of different metals and ceramics that result in a strong armor without sacrificing flexibility.
ARMOR_3_DESC: Plasteel is an elastic material that combines many of the qualities of plastics and metal. It is relatively cheap to produce and can be used to augment ship armor.
ARMOR_4_DESC: This strong yet flexible material is capable of withstanding severe punishment. It serves well as ship armor.
ARMOR_5_DESC: This incredibly dense and strong material can resist firepower that would turn armor made of any other alloys into slag.
CRYSTAL_ARMOR_1_DESC: An alloy of elements harvested from the ultra-hard Crystalline Entities lines the inner layers of this plating, improving hull integrity.
CRYSTAL_ARMOR_2_DESC: Modifications to the process of forging the crystalline alloy further improves its durability.
SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
DESTROYER_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
CRUISER_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
BATTLESHIP_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
TITAN_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
COLOSSUS_SHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC: Simple yet moderately effective chemical thrusters that rely on combustible propellant to generate thrust.
SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
DESTROYER_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
CRUISER_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
BATTLESHIP_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
TITAN_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
COLOSSUS_SHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC: These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
DESTROYER_SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
CRUISER_SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
BATTLESHIP_SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
TITAN_SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
COLOSSUS_SHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC: An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
SHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
DESTROYER_SHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
CRUISER_SHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
BATTLESHIP_SHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
TITAN_SHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
COLOSSUS_SHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC: These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
ftl_inhibitor_DESC: Enemy ships will be unable to leave the system along any other point than the one they entered from.
SCOUT_HANGAR_1_DESC: A flight of Scout craft provides basic strike craft capability, harassing enemy bombers and strike craft in the vicinity of the mothership.
STRIKE_CRAFT_HANGAR_1_DESC: Designed to operate with a base of operation close by, these transorbital fighters could be used to harass enemy ships.
STRIKE_CRAFT_HANGAR_2_DESC: The next generation of strike craft, featuring improved avionics, better handling characteristics and more powerful armaments.
STRIKE_CRAFT_HANGAR_3_DESC: A further refinement in strike craft design, these advanced strike craft are a pilot's dream. Their performance far exceeds that of previous models.
SPACE_WHALE_WEAPON_1_DESC: Modeled after a peculiar biological process observed in the Tiyanki, the Energy Siphon excites the energy transfer medium of targeted enemy vessels.
CORVETTE_FISSION_REACTOR_DESC: This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.
CORVETTE_FUSION_REACTOR_DESC: Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.
CORVETTE_COLD_FUSION_REACTOR_DESC: The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.
CORVETTE_ANTIMATTER_REACTOR_DESC: By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.
CORVETTE_ZERO_POINT_REACTOR_DESC: These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.
CORVETTE_DARK_MATTER_REACTOR_DESC: These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.

COMBAT_COMPUTER_SWARM_ADVANCED_DESC: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.
COMBAT_COMPUTER_PICKET_ADVANCED_DESC: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.
COMBAT_COMPUTER_LINE_ADVANCED_DESC: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.
COMBAT_COMPUTER_ARTILLERY_ADVANCED_DESC: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.
COMBAT_COMPUTER_PLATFORM_ADVANCED_DESC: Further advances in predictive algorithms allow for augmented tactical decision-making in the field.
COMBAT_COMPUTER_SWARM_AUTONOMOUS_DESC: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.
COMBAT_COMPUTER_PICKET_AUTONOMOUS_DESC: Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.

COMBAT_COMPUTER_SWARM_PRECOG_DESC: Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.
COMBAT_COMPUTER_PICKET_PRECOG_DESC: Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.

POINT_DEFENCE_1_DESC: Hull-mounted countermeasures against missiles and strike craft are often essential for larger and slower military vessels.
POINT_DEFENCE_2_DESC: Updated prediction algorithms improves tracking and point-defense efficiency.
POINT_DEFENCE_3_DESC: A wider range of available ammunition types vastly improves the effective interception rate of incoming threats.
PLANET_KILLER_CRACKER_DESC: A directed feed of thermic energy superheats the atmosphere and agitates the planet's core, setting up disastrous tectonic events. A final and comparatively minute concussive blast is then delivered, cracking the planet open.
PLANET_KILLER_SHIELDER_DESC: A shielding field is deployed around a planet, creating a barrier that is permanent and impenetrable (save for some wavelengths of light).
PLANET_KILLER_NEUTRON_DESC: An accelerated plume of neutron radiation "paints" the planet surface, severely degrading most materials and directly destroying biological tissue.
PLANET_KILLER_GODRAY_DESC: A psionic projector shines divine truth upon the world to make true believers out of all who are capable of belief, and annihilating those who are not.
PLANET_KILLER_NANOBOTS_DESC: Swarms of nanobots are dispersed in the atmosphere. They infect sapient beings and restructure themselves into cybernetic implants, turning their unwitting hosts into cyborgs slaved to the Machine Intelligence.
SMALL_CRYSTAL_SHIP_BLUE_LIGHTNING_DESC: The Blue Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Sapphire-class Crystalline Entities to inflict damage.
SMALL_CRYSTAL_SHIP_GREEN_LIGHTNING_DESC: The Green Shard Thrower mimics the weaponized emissions of the Emerald-class Crystalline Entities to inflict middling damage.

MEDIUM_PROBE_LIGHTNING_DESC: An unusual form of weaponry, this energy emitter closely resembles other energy weapons in function, but operates with a frequency and within a spectrum never before weaponized.
SPACE_CLOUD_LIGHTNING_DESC: Utilizing our understanding of the fundamental forces involved in generating the Void Clouds' considerable internal charge to the fullest, the Cloud Lightning weapon system is a potent damage-dealer.
SPACE_WHALE_WEAPON_DESC: Modeled after a peculiar biological process observed in the Tiyanki, the Energy Siphon excites the energy transfer medium of targeted enemy vessels.
LARGE_SPACE_AMOEBA_WEAPON_DESC: The weaponized emissions of the Space Amoebas are truly a marvel of evolution.
AMOEBA_STRIKE_CRAFT_DESC: Amoebas bred in captivity spawn Flagella that can be imprinted to respond to subtle shifts in hull magnetization, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.
SWARM_STRIKE_CRAFT_DESC: Cloned, miniaturized Prethoryn specimen can be controlled through wavelengths close to those we use for intra-fleet communication, allowing us to use them as effective strike craft.
LARGE_SCOURGE_MISSILE_1_DESC: The Scourge Missile payloads are made up of many of the biochemical compounds used by the Swarm in interstellar combat, having proven unexpectedly effective against even the hardiest of military vessels.
LARGE_ED_WEAPON_DESC: Hailing from another dimension, the core technologies of the Matter Disintegrator bends several physical laws for destructive results.
MEDIUM_ED_WEAPON_DESC: Hailing from another dimension, the core technologies of the Matter Disintegrator bends several physical laws for destructive results.
SMALL_ED_WEAPON_DESC: Hailing from another dimension, the core technologies of the Matter Disintegrator bends several physical laws for destructive results.
DRAGON_ARMOR_DESC: The Ether Drake's scales are made up of multiple layers of unique mineral nanostructures. Unorthodox manufacturing techniques allow us to closely emulate these self-repairing structures.
DARK_MATTER_DEFLECTOR_DESC: These deflectors utilize dark matter to deflect incoming projectiles in a way that seems to utterly defy the laws of nature.
ENIGMATIC_DECODER_DESC: While producing average results in standard tests, the accuracy of Enigmatic Decoder's prediction algorithms seemingly increases as the target's flight path grows more erratic.
ENIGMATIC_ENCODER_DESC: The Enigmatic Encoder scrambles flight path data according to some indeterminable design before feeding it back to fleet command.
ENIGMATIC_DISRUPTION_FIELD_DESC: By flooding a localized area with weak, randomly-modulated electromagnetic pulses, enemy shield and weapons systems can be partially disrupted.

PLANET_KILLER_STAR_CRACKER_DESC:
A beam of directed tachyon energy is fired into the star, triggering a supernova. The incredible energy released by this event is then used to generate vast quantities of dark matter.

When the star detonates, ALL colonies, megastructures, and stations in the system are destroyed - including our own. All fleets in the system will go MIA. The Star-Eater itself is the only exception.
PLANET_KILLER_CHRONITON_0_DESC: Unleash the effects of the devastating Temporal incursion beam to alter the history of our target.
PLANET_KILLER_SOLAR_CRACKER_DESC: Using the might of the Kessok's Solar forming technology the power of a Sun can be wiped out.
PLANET_KILLER_SUPER_BIO_ANTI_0_DESC: An immense weapon developed by the Undine that super heats the planet's core by creating a fluidic rift at the heart of the world.
PLANET_KILLER_SUPER_BIO_INFEST_0_DESC: Unleash the devastating Virus that consumes and converts all matter into Bio-Mass fit only for the native species of Fluidic Space.

REQUIRED_DEFENSE_BORG_2_A_DESC:
Technology Level: 2
The neuro-electric field is produced by linking drones' lower brain functions together. This allows healthy drones to greatly increase the rate of recovery of injured drones, by neurologically superimposing the correct functioning of damaged components, guiding the healing process. The same technique is applied to our vessels' systems and repair nanoprobes, increasing repair rates.

Enough plasma is stored that they can also be routed to the primary exhaust manifold, providing a medium term speed increase.

STARBASE_AURA_DISRUPTION_DESC: These devices can leech energy from nearby vessels, leaving them moribund and derelict.

STARBASE_AURA_TRACTOR_DESC: A collimated beam of gravitons is used to hold various objects, anything from space debris to a ship.
STARBASE_AURA_TRAFFIC_DESC: Powerful navigational arrays provide a substantial boost to sublight travel across the system.

required_aura_battleship_DESC: This battleship module manages, transmits and coordinates numerous shielding frequencies of nearby vessels, thus strengthening their protection.
required_aura_battleship_borg_repair_1_D:
Technology Level: 0

Using phased energy beams, nanoprobes are delivered to a vessel's damaged hull segment to begin repair without losing tactical efficiency
required_aura_battleship_borg_repair_2_D:
Technology Level: 1

With the addition of an advanced targeting node, phased energy beams are able to deliver nanoprobes to the precise location of a damaged hull segment. This allows us to repair our vessels quickly and efficiently.
required_aura_battleship_borg_repair_3_D:
Technology Level: 3

Triaxilating beams focus on damaged segments of hull in order to repair them rapidly and efficiently. Nearby vessels repair quickly and efficiently.
required_aura_battleship_borg_repair_4_D:
Technology Level: 9

Nanite fields can be projected over large areas of a damaged hull in order to prepare damaged segments. Nearby vessels repair quickly and efficiently.
required_aura_battleship_borg_tractor_1_:
Technology Level: 0

A powerful tractor beam utilised by the Borg. It can hold even large ships at bay, and also be used in warp.
required_aura_battleship_borg_tractor_2_:
Technology Level: 3

The addition of a cutting beam to the already deadly Borg tractor beam allows the Borg to carve held enemy ships into pieces.
required_aura_battleship_borg_tractor_3_:
Technology Level: 7

With more power directed at the cutting beam, the Borg can literally hold ships in place whilst they carve enemy fleets into pieces.
required_aura_battleship_borg_tractor_4_:
Technology Level: 10

With multiple emitters allowing the cutting beam to be focused on particularly hardened sections to hold vessels in place, the Borg can literally carve enemy fleets into pieces.
required_aura_battleship_breen_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

A new component that is solely available to the Breen. They discovered that, by calculating a new set of modulated beam frequencies when their battleships fire their weapon, it can actually decrease the rate of fire of enemy vessels.
required_aura_battleship_breen_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Enhancements to the energy dissipator enable more weapon energy to be drained from the enemy, thus reducing their rate of fire further.
required_aura_battleship_breen_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Enhancements to the energy dissipator enable more weapon energy to be drained from the enemy, thus reducing their rate of fire further.

Our hyper-spatial dissipator forms subspace anomalies that drain and dampen the formation of energy within foreign intermix chambers, thus reducing the power of enemy weapons.

A simple jamming technique, further enhanced by the Gorn, reflects optical sensors thus rendering vessels hard to detect or target.
required_aura_battleship_gorn_jammer_2_D:
Technology Level: 5

Gravimetric particles are used to surround a vessel, making it extremely difficult to target accurately.
required_aura_battleship_gorn_jammer_3_D:

required_aura_cruiser_web_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

By sheathing the filament spinners in an antimatter web, a superluminal web can be constructed which further clamps down upon enemy vessels.
required_aura_destroyer_DESC: This destroyer module manages, transmits and coordinates numerous shielding frequencies of nearby vessels, thus strengthening their protection.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_adaptive_0_:
Technology Level: 1

Basic Borg Plexus providing low level computer core services and regenerative abilities.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_adaptive_1_:
Technology Level: 5

This plexus has been adapted to facilitate increased interlinking of regenerating drones' brains into an organic computer core. This results in more comprehensive weapon neutralisation data for nearby Borg vessels.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_adaptive_2_:
Technology Level: 6

Central plexus enhancements facilitate even faster and more efficient transfer of the Collective's knowledge and real time tactical data, further aiding the nullification of hostile resistance.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_adaptive_3_:
Technology Level: 8

Quantum-speed signal relay nodes throughout the central plexus enable near-instantaneous corrections to adaptation protocols, drastically increasing baseline protection against enemy weapons systems.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_adaptive_4_:
Technology Level: 9

Transwarp carrier-wave communications protocols allow for temporally-asynchronous updating of adaptive countermeasures, neutralising most enemy weapons before they even fire.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_repair_1_DE:
Technology Level: 0

Using phased energy beams, nanoprobes are delivered to a vessel's damaged hull segment to begin repair without losing tactical efficiency.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_repair_2_DE:
Technology Level: 1

With the addition of an advanced targeting node, phased energy beams are able to deliver nanoprobes to the precise location of a damaged hull segment. This allows us to repair our vessels quickly and efficiently.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_repair_3_DE:
Technology Level: 3

Triaxilating beams focus on damaged segments of hull in order to repair them rapidly and efficiently. Nearby vessels repair quickly and efficiently.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_repair_4_DE:
Technology Level: 9

Nanite fields can be projected over large areas of a damaged hull in order to prepare damaged segments. Nearby vessels repair quickly and efficiently.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_tractor_1_D:
Technology Level: 0

A powerful tractor beam utilised by the Borg. It can hold even large ships at bay, and also be used at warp.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_tractor_2_D:
Technology Level: 2

The addition of a cutting beam to the already deadly Borg tractor beam allows the Borg to carve held enemy ships into pieces.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_tractor_3_D:
Technology Level: 5

With more power directed at the cutting beam, the Borg can literally hold ships in place whilst they carve enemy fleets into pieces.
required_aura_destroyer_borg_tractor_4_D:
Technology Level: 10

With multiple emitters allowing the cutting beam to be focused on particularly hardened sections to hold vessels in place, the Borg can literally carve enemy fleets into pieces.
required_aura_destroyer_breen_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

A new component that is solely available to the Breen. They discovered that, by calculating a new set of modulated beam frequencies when their battleships fire their weapon, it can actually decrease the rate of fire of enemy vessels.
required_aura_destroyer_breen_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Enhancements to the energy dissipator enable more weapon energy to be drained from the enemy, thus reducing their rate of fire further.
required_aura_destroyer_breen_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Enhancements to the energy dissipator enable more weapon energy to be drained from the enemy, thus reducing their rate of fire further.
required_aura_destroyer_breen_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

Our hyper-spatial dissipator forms subspace anomalies that drain and dampen the formation of energy within foreign intermix chambers, thus reducing the power of enemy weapons.
required_aura_destroyer_defense_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

This unique device is more than a typical inertial damper. Instead, it's a complex array of backup inertial control device spread out across the ship and linked to highly calibrated gyroscopes. This system allows the ship to resist almost every type of kinetic and spatial form of attack or hindrance.

This device makes the ship immune to all form of hostile snare auras.
required_aura_destroyer_gorn_jammer_1_DE:
Technology Level: 3

A simply jamming technique, further enhanced by the Gorn, this reflects optical sensors thus rendering vessels hard to detect or target.
required_aura_destroyer_gorn_jammer_2_DE:
Technology Level: 5

Gravimetric particles are used to surround a vessel, making it extremely difficult to target accurately.
required_aura_destroyer_gorn_jammer_3_DE:
Technology Level: 7

Unique to the Gorn, the subspace jammer masks a vessel's energy signature within a subspace field, making it extremely difficult to detect.
required_aura_destroyer_gorn_jammer_4: Gorn Mk. V Holographic Spoofing Jammer
required_aura_destroyer_gorn_jammer_4_DE:
Technology Level: 10

Unique to the Gorn, the Holographical Spoofing Jammer creates hard light imagery to fool even the most detailed sensors.
required_aura_destroyer_inhibitor_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

The Tkon Empire once used entire planets to act as warp inhibitors. Whilst this isn't quite a planet, it does however use the same ideas. A large artificial gravity well is created, slowing down the creation of any warp bubbles, and dragging ships out of warp if they pass through.
required_aura_destroyer_inhibitor_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

Isolytic weapons cause a tear in subspace near the target. The anomaly then moves towards the target at the speed of light wreaking havoc upon warp engines.
required_aura_destroyer_inhibitor_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

A temporal shock wave is a powerful buildup of temporal energy which travels through space, causing timeline disruption as it propagates and wreaking havoc with ship systems.
required_aura_destroyer_sweeper_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

This module allows the remote targeting and triggering of enemy minefields, thus negating their damage.
required_aura_destroyer_tractor_1_DESC: The grappler fires a clawed magnetic grappler attached to a heavy nanopolymer tow cable that can grapple objects in space. The grappler utilises a magnetic lock device to attach to objects.
required_aura_destroyer_tractor_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

A collimated beam of gravitons is used to hold various objects, anything from space debris to a ship.
required_aura_destroyer_tractor_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

In order to hold larger objects or non-solid objects, the tractor beam is enhanced with highsurge energy pulses, enabling it to move massive objects such as stellar core fragments.
required_aura_destroyer_tractor_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Remodulating the tractor beams to account for subspace interference allows these tractor beams to hold objects through shields and other obstacles.
required_aura_destroyer_web_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

The Tholian web, or tractor net, is composed of a series of energy filaments which are generated in a web pattern around a target vessel. Once these filaments are sealed, the web becomes self-generating and the web-spinning crafts are no longer needed to maintain the web.
required_aura_destroyer_web_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

The Tholian web, or tractor net, is composed of a series of energy filaments which are generated in a web pattern around a target vessel. This module allows the creation of the energy filaments.
required_aura_destroyer_web_3_DESC:

required_aura_destroyer_web_4_DESC:

Technology Level: 6

Drydock facilities providing repair bays and engineering crews to make repairs to friendly ships.
required_aura_loaned_cloak_DESC:

Device provided by the Romulan Star Empire to investigate unusual activity in the Gamma Quadrant.

required_hero_computer_1_DESC: By utilising the intrinsic spin of the electron, this solid state computer can be dedicated to weapon systems.
required_hero_computer_2_DESC: Optical computers represent a significant advancement in tactical simulation. By installing these upgrades all around our starship we will see an increased performance to our starships weapon systems.
required_hero_computer_3_DESC: We have designed new computer components based on the breakthroughs in duotronic technology developed by Dr. Richard Daystrom. These revolutionary new computational systems are capable of the advanced calculations needed to noticeably improve target locks and weapon tuning optimisations.
required_hero_computer_4_DESC: Multitronic computers utilise very sophisticated technology based on next-level deep neural webs. This allows for a computer that can think and reason, and eventually, even assist in strategy development, ship management and research.
required_hero_computer_5_DESC: Our understanding of isolinear chip technology has given us the ability to design a new type of computer component that will feature these advanced nanoprocessors to aid in the tactical simulations of our starships weapons, however, due to the easily corruptible nature of these chips, our weapon damage will be very similar to that of our Duotronic based computers.
required_hero_computer_6_DESC: A new type of computer component designed from bio-neural gel packs help store more information and operate at faster speeds than our previous isolinear computers designs, thereby increasing our tactical simulations to our starship weapon systems by a sizable amount.
required_hero_computer_7_DESC: Using advanced cortical implants, every member of the crew can access quickly and inutility every facet of the ship controls at any time and from any location. Merging this tactic with next-stage neural gel computer network, the ship becomes almost a living thing, capable of performing a great deal of calculations instantaneously and predict enemy movement in an almost instinctive way.
required_science_anti_cloak_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

A Gravitational Field Emitter can be used to detect micro-shifts in the gravitational field around a cloaked vessel allowing limited detection of cloaked vessels using weak cloaking devices.
required_science_anti_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

A targetted sweep can pickup energy 'distortions', manifesting themselves most often as refracting visible light energy from surrounding stellar objects very near the cloaked ship's outline, appearing as a 'shimmering' effect, while cloaked and prior to decloaking, could give away a cloaked ship when observed.
required_science_anti_cloak_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

A tachyon detection grid was a technique developed as a means of detecting cloaked warships. The grid used active tachyon beams transmitted between different starships or sentry posts to create a tachyon field; any cloaked ship entering this field would be exposed.
required_science_anti_cloak_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

These beacons were positron-based, and had an output of two hundred gigawatts. The subassembly tolerances were isolated from the emitter algorithms, which was made possible by generating a stable flux between the positronic conductors and renormalizing the tertiary wave functions.
required_science_backup_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Supplementary air, water and power. Without these, death in space is easily achieved.
required_science_escape_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Enhanced escape pods provide increased survivability for the crew and leaders in case of disaster.
required_science_fed_cloak_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Sensor blocking is enhanced by holographic emitters projecting a camouflage, disguising the vessel as another object, such as an asteroid or comet.
required_science_fed_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

Light diffusion and sensor blocking are further augmented by chroniton particle generation. This combination allows a ship to move seamlessly through solid matter.
required_science_generic_cloak_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Basic light and radar diffusion system. Equipped vessels are harder to detect at medium- to long-range.
required_science_generic_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Spatial Displacement shifts objects slightly out of phase with our space-time continuum, acting as a highly advanced cloaking device.
required_science_generic_cloak_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 11

Through the generation of a chroniton field, a high state of temporal polarisation is created, putting the ship in a state of temporal flux. This moves it slightly out of phase with space-time, making it extremely difficult to detect.
required_science_kdf_cloak_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Basic light and radar diffusion system. Equipped vessels are harder to detect at medium- to long-range.
required_science_kdf_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

Equipped vessels are nearly impossible to detect with the naked eye or with most sensor systems
required_science_lab_engineering_1_DESC:

required_science_lab_physics_1_DESC:

required_science_lab_society_1_DESC:

required_science_rom_cloak_1_DESC:

required_science_rom_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

required_science_rom_cloak_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

Through the generation of dual cloaking fields, a high state of polarisation is created, putting the ship in a state of flux. This moves it slightly out of phase with space-time, making it extremely difficult to detect.
required_science_specialisation_diplomac: Science Ships are equipped with additional embassy modules, allowing science vessels to aid planetary government.
required_science_specialisation_engineer: Science Ships are equipped with additional engineering modules, allowing science vessels to assist planetary infrastructure as long as an engineering leader leads the fleet.
required_science_specialisation_flagship: Flagships are equipped with Flagship facilities and modules allowing this ship to perform flagship planetary missions.
required_science_specialisation_medical_: Science Ships are equipped with additional medical modules, allowing science vessels to Set up orbital hospitals as long as a medical leader leads the fleet.
required_science_specialisation_science_: Science Ships are equipped with the default module, allowing science vessels to Assist Planetary Research.
required_science_specialisation_security: This ship is equipped with security facilities and modules allowing this ship to assist planet security.
required_sensor_civilian_1_DESC: A basic radar system that increases sensor range on our civilian vessels.
required_sensor_mobile_station_1_DESC: A basic radar system that increases sensor range on our starbases.
required_sensor_mobile_station_2_DESC:

These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
required_sensor_mobile_station_3_DESC:

required_sensor_mobile_station_4_DESC:
