Sensors that penetrate even the most advanced interference caused by natural and unnatural means leading to vastly increased sensor range and detection capabilities of the movement of enemy starships.
required_sensor_starbase_1_DESC: A basic radar system that increases sensor range on our starbases.
required_sensor_starbase_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
required_sensor_starbase_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

These sensors have been tuned to more precisely detect the decay of tachyons emitted by all warp-capable starships, resulting in increased detection range and tracking capabilities.
required_sensor_starbase_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

These sensors have been tuned to scan all multiphasic bands allowing it to pick up signals emitted by all warp-capable starships, resulting in increased detection range and tracking capabilities.
required_sensor_station_1_DESC: A basic radar system that increases sensor range on our stations
required_sensor_station_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
required_sensor_station_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

These sensors have been tuned to more precisely detect the decay of tachyons emitted by all warp capable starships, resulting in increased detection range and tracking capabilities.
required_sensor_station_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

These sensors have been tuned to scan all multiphasic bands allowing it to pick up signals emitted by all warp capable starships, resulting in increased detection range and tracking capabilities.
required_tactical_agony_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Agony booths are installed within the vessel, providing a way to dispose of traitorous crew or lacklustre crew.
required_tactical_akira_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

A specialised weapons pod for the Akira class carrying 13 torpedo launchers.
required_tactical_anti_cloak_1_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

A Gravitational Field Emitter can be used to detect micro-shifts in the gravitational field around a cloaked vessel allowing limited detection of cloaked vessels using weak cloaking devices.
required_tactical_anti_cloak_2_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

A targetted sweep can pickup energy 'distortions', manifesting themselves most often as refracting visible light energy from surrounding stellar objects very near the cloaked ship's outline, appearing as a 'shimmering' effect, while cloaked and prior to decloaking, could give away a cloaked ship when observed.
required_tactical_anti_cloak_3_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

A tachyon detection grid was a technique developed as a means of detecting cloaked warships. The grid used active tachyon beams transmitted between different starships or sentry posts to create a tachyon field; any cloaked ship entering this field would be exposed.
required_tactical_anti_cloak_4_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

These beacons were positron-based, and had an output of two hundred gigawatts. The subassembly tolerances were isolated from the emitter algorithms, which was made possible by generating a stable flux between the positronic conductors and renormalizing the tertiary wave functions.
required_tactical_ares_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

By maintaining the correct temperature of the warp plasma at all times, it can be injected into key systems to provide a short term power boost when required.
required_tactical_backup_DESC: Supplementary air, water and power. Without these, death in space is easily achieved.
required_tactical_bio_mod_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Undine Cells have powerful regeneration properties, this same biological practice is applied to the hulls of Undine ships.
required_tactical_bio_mod_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Undine Cells have powerful regeneration properties, this same biological practice is applied to the hulls of Undine ships. The upgraded module provides greater regenerative power.
required_tactical_bio_mod_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Undine Cells have powerful regeneration properties, this same biological practice is applied to the hulls of Undine ships.
required_tactical_bio_mod_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Undine Cells have powerful regeneration properties, this same biological practice is applied to the hulls of Undine ships.
required_tactical_bio_mod_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

Undine Cells have powerful regeneration properties, this same biological practice is applied to the hulls of Undine ships.
required_tactical_boarding_pods_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Equipped with assault pods, capable of delivering boarding parties onto an enemies ship.
required_tactical_chevron_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

Starship separation is a maneuver performed by some Federation starships involving the complete disconnection of the primary hull and the secondary hull.
required_tactical_coil_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

A pair of backup warp coils that are primed and ready to enable a quick escape.
required_tactical_coil_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Auxillary warp coils are tied in to the main system, ready to be brought online at a moments notice in case of rapid tactical relocation.
required_tactical_constellation_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

A unique controller is built into the Constellation's four nacelled design, allowing precise short range warp jumps to be enacted.
required_tactical_constitution_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

This sensor allows the detection of cloaked vessels by picking up their waste heat from their plasma exhaust.
required_tactical_crossfield_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

A unique three part saucer where upon the central section is allowed to freely rotate as part of the excess energy cavitation.
required_tactical_crossfield_jump_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

A unique controller is built into the Crossfield's rotating design, allowing microjumps to be calculated for use in rapid succession.
required_tactical_dauntless_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

Slipstream is perhaps the fastest known means of travel, utlizing improved transwarp conduits that have different properties than standard space. The computer is designed to locate them along warp corridors, speeding up exploration.
required_tactical_defiant_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

Ablative armour is a type of protective hull armor used on starships, which possesses a capability for rapidly dissipating the energy impacts from directed energy weapon fire.
required_tactical_dervish_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

A console component that uses a sophisticated set of mono-spectrum sub-tools that will increases the damage of our ship's weapons.
required_tactical_duderstadt_DESC:
Technology Level: 11

Revolutionary dual sensor array installed within the seconardary hull, separated from the base of the ship to provide clearer scans.
required_tactical_engineering_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is engineering in nature and will allow our crew to greatly reinforce the structure of the ship's hull. 

This console, allows this fleet to complete the Assist Planetary Build and Production fleet action.
required_tactical_escape_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Enhanced escape pods provide increased survivability for the crew and leaders in case of disaster.
required_tactical_excelsior_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

Transwarp is an extremely fast form of propulsion, utlizing transwarp conduits that have different properties than standard space. The computer is designed to locate them along warp corridors, speeding up exploration.
required_tactical_fed_cloak_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Sensor blocking is enhanced by holographic emitters projecting a camouflage, disguising the vessel as another object, such as an asteroid or comet.

Holographic Camouflage gives ships a temporary 20% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 60 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_fed_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

Light diffusion and sensor blocking are further augmented by chroniton particle generation. This combination allows a ship to move seamlessly through solid matter.

Interphase Cloaking Generators give ships a temporary 30% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 60 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_fed_marines_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

A regiment of MACO troops onboard the ship, capable of being deployed during battle.
required_tactical_fed_marines_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

A regiment of Starfleet Marines onboard the ship, capable of being deployed during battle capable of damaging attacking ships.
required_tactical_focus_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

By absorbing passing photon streams to boost the gain on the focusing array, we can divert more power into weapon systems.
required_tactical_freedom_tng_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

The over powered nacelle allows for additional power to be directed to a dedicated mining laser, which can be used as a makeshift weapon during battle.
required_tactical_generic_cloak_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Basic light and radar diffusion system. Equipped vessels are harder to detect at medium- to long-range.

Basic Cloaking Generators give ships a temporary 20% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 60 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_generic_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Spatial Displacement shifts objects slightly out of phase with our space-time continuum, acting as a highly advanced cloaking device.

Spatial Displacement Cloaking Generators give ships a temporary 25% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 60 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_generic_cloak_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 11

Through the generation of a chroniton field, a high state of temporal polarisation is created, putting the ship in a state of temporal flux. This moves it slightly out of phase with space-time, making it extremely difficult to detect.

Temporal Cloaking Generators give ships a temporary 30% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 60 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_gorn_hunter_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

The Gorn Hunters move in a manner that is almost completely alien, almost as if the vessels are one with the Gorn who hunt their prey.
required_tactical_inquiry_DESC:
Technology Level: 11

The toughest, fastest, most powerful ship Starfleet ever put into service utilizing the latest shield-enhancing technology built from technology salvaged from the reclamation project.
required_tactical_intrepid_hologram_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

The Emergency Medical Hologram or EMH is a sophisticated holographic programme used upon Starfleet starships and facilities to assist medical staff in times of emergency.
required_tactical_intrepid_pylon_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

These nacelles are not fixed immobile to the hull of the starship, but rather move into position when the warp engine is powered. This action lessens the harmful effect of warp travel on space and subspace.
required_tactical_kdf_cloak_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Basic light and radar diffusion system. Equipped vessels are harder to detect at medium- to long-range.

Invisibility Barrier Generators give ships a temporary 20% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 60 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_kdf_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

Equipped vessels are nearly impossible to detect with the naked eye or with most sensor systems.

Prototype Raider Cloaking Generators give ships a temporary 25% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 120 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_kdf_marines_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

A detachment of highly trained Klingon Warriors ready to be deployed on ship invasion tactics.
required_tactical_kdf_marines_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

A detachment of highly trained Klingon Warriors ready to be deployed on ship invasion tactics.
required_tactical_kdf_marines_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

A detachment of highly trained Klingon Warriors ready to be deployed on ship invasion tactics.
required_tactical_kessok_solar_DESC:
Technology Level: 

Unique solar panels capable of converting solar energy into enough power to fuel this mightly ship.
required_tactical_miranda_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

The sensor pod is a module that can be connected to the sides of the Miranda-class to extend it's sensor capability.
required_tactical_nebula_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

The sensor pod is a module that can be connected to the dorsal surface of the Nebula-class to extend it's sensor capability.
required_tactical_neo_constitution_DESC:
Technology Level: 11

A radical array of omni directional impulse drive boosters positioned across the hull provide the Constitution III with the best size to agility ratio across the fleet.
required_tactical_olympic_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

Fully dedicated Medical facilities allow for rapid recovery of crew and aiding those in need, but it comes at the cost of the offensive abilities of the ship.
required_tactical_pack_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Ships operate better when in a small fleet capable of working together as part of a coordinated attack.
required_tactical_pathfinder_DESC:
Technology Level: 11

A revolutionary deflector technology that allows pinpoint slipstream jumps, allowing for longer and safer jumps using slipsteam drive.
required_tactical_precog_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

A console component that takes into account new algorithms to predict an enemy ship's movement thus increasing the chance to hit an enemy ship with weapon fire.
required_tactical_prometheus_multi_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Multi-vector assault mode allows the vessel to divide into three sections, each with its own warp core and warp drive capability, able to conduct piloted or remote-controlled movement and attack activities.
required_tactical_range_sensor_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Detecting the minute changes in subspace and the differential allows for unique targeting opportunities.
required_tactical_rewinder_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

A console based cutting edge temporal research, it uses a closed temporal loop to create duplicates of our starships for a short period of times.
required_tactical_rom_cloak_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Basic holographic and radar diffusion system. Equipped vessels are harder to detect at medium- to long-range.

Holographic Cloaking Generators give ships a temporary 20% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 60 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_rom_cloak_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Light diffusion and sensor blocking is further augmented by chroniton particle generation.

Multiphasic Cloaking Generators give ships a temporary 25% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 60 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_rom_cloak_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

Through the generation of dual cloaking fields, a high state of polarisation is created, putting the ship in a state of flux. This moves it slightly out of phase with space-time, making it extremely difficult to detect.

Dual Cloaking Generators give ships a temporary 30% damage bonus to all attacks at the start of space combat. This bonus lasts for 120 days. After the battle, it takes the generator some time to recharge - the bonus cannot be applied again for 180 days.
required_tactical_rom_marines_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

A unit of Reman Infiltrators ready to board another ship and disrupt its operation.
required_tactical_sagan_DESC:
Technology Level: 11

Years of studying engagements and debris left over from attacks by the Borg have allowed us to create a number of enhancements that improve our ships abilities.
required_tactical_science_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is scientific in nature and will provide our ships with increased evasion, tracking and targeting. 

This console, allows this fleet to complete the Assist Planetary Research fleet action.
required_tactical_scout_sensors_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Scout Class Vessels can be equipped with focused long range sensors that can track ship movements and combined with the Scouts speed allow for reconnaissance missions.
required_tactical_shangri_la_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

Specifically designed impulse-boosting thrusters that provide an additional thrust when maneuvering at high impulse speeds.
required_tactical_snakehead_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

A holographic cloaking projectorwhich could be reversed to project a false decoy image of the ship.
required_tactical_space_station_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Specially installed modules designed to focus the starbase on a tactical output.
required_tactical_space_station_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Specially installed modules designed to focus the starbase on a engineering output.
required_tactical_space_station_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Specially installed modules designed to focus the starbase on a science output.
required_tactical_spitfire_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

The Temporal Spitfire uses closed temporal loop technology to shunt weapons energy into temporal phase, resulting in a large increase to the rate of fire.
required_tactical_structural_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

The integration of a central structural integrity field supplements the supports and bulkheads of a spaceship's shape.
required_tactical_tactical_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is tactical in nature and will allow our crew to safely divert energy to increase the maximum damage of our weapons systems. 

This console, allows this fleet to complete the Assist Planetary Governance fleet action.
required_tactical_tracking_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

An exographic targeting sensor is a sensor capable of visually penetrating almost any surface allowing its users to literally see through hulls, walls or barriers. Its range can be adjusted to allow the user to see up to only a certain point.
required_tactical_typhon_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Once the Typhon deploys its array of fighters, it is able to deploy additional ablative armour and retract core systems to provide better protection at the cost of maneuverability.
required_tactical_walker_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Armoured panels break away from the hull of the vessel in the event of escape pod launch.
utility_aux_backup_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

Supplementary air, water and power. Without these, death in space is easily achieved.
utility_aux_backup_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

A redundant life support system can be built into the vessel in order to increase survivability when heavily damaged.
utility_aux_backup_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Triple redundant life support systems offer increased survivability to the crew of a stricken vessel.
utility_aux_backup_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

In the event of total crew loss or incapacitation, the emergency command system can activate and take over the running of the vessel, ensuring optimum chance of survival or retrieval.
utility_aux_borg_alcove_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

Cortical processing subunits produce too much information for a drone to assimilate while active, so it must be uploaded while the drone regenerates. These alcoves have been enhanced with uplinks to the local cortical processing subunit to facilitate this, improving each drones operational efficiency.
utility_aux_borg_alcove_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Alcoves concentrated into high capacity clusters, instead of distributed around the vessel. Better access, and higher energy power connections combine to reduce the time that drones spend away from performing useful tasks.
utility_aux_borg_alcove_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

These alcoves work together with an induction charging system. Nanoprobes form a thin mobile charging pad which follows individual drones around the vessel. These pads supply the drones with a small amounts supply of power, decreasing the frequency with which they must regenerate.
utility_aux_borg_alcove_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

While minor improvements have been made to the armour of each drone, most of the improvements have been applied to these alcoves. Force field emitters protect drones while regenerating, preventing further injury and delay in returning to performing useful functions.
utility_aux_bulkhead_1_DESC: Additional bulkheads situated throughout the vessel will provide a boost to structural integrity and hull points.
utility_aux_cargo_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

The cargo bay allows for the free loading and storage of numerous goods, and can be secured against intrusion. 

Cargo Bays: Allows the ship to partake in the deliver supplies fleet action.
utility_aux_command_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

A console component that can be installed on our spaceship bridge. This one is related to command and control in nature and will allow our crew to safely optimise control of the vessel from this point.
utility_aux_command_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Additional command stations on the bridge offer improved command support to the vessel.
utility_aux_command_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

When the bridge is knocked out, the secondary bridge can take over. It can be manned during normal operation too, to relieve the pressure on the main bridge.
utility_aux_command_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

The holographic command station can be accessed across the vessel providing full command and control over the local area.
utility_aux_crew_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

Simple stacked crew pods, with limited shared facilities.
utility_aux_crew_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Common crew bunks, usually stacked four to a room. Facilities are shared by each bunkroom.
utility_aux_crew_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Small private rooms with senior staff having access to their own sonic shower and eating facilities.
utility_aux_crew_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

Larger rooms for crew members, with their own lounge, bed and eating facilities. Married quarters are available for families.
utility_aux_emitter_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

We have come up with a utility device, that generates large field of gravitons for sustained periods of time. These new emitters will increase the regeneration process of our shields.
utility_aux_emitter_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Through recent advances in graviton emitters our effectiveness of regenerating our shields via our shield emitters have increased.
utility_aux_emitter_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

By reducing the discharge rate of our shield capacitors we believe we can make our shield emitters re-energise faster, thus increasing the rate in which our shields will regenerate.
utility_aux_emitter_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Recent capacitor advances have enabled the installation of nano-shield capacitors which can discharge and rapidly restore our shields.
utility_aux_operation_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

With the continued use of combat oriented workstations we have studied what our operations officers find useful and what they find distracting. As a result our computer scientists have come up with a more streamlined interface to this workstation, that better suits the needs onboard ship.
utility_aux_operation_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

An updated dual officer work station with enhanced sensors that can be installed on a ship's bridge which will let us better track the movements of enemy vessels.
utility_aux_operation_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

The installation of a Master Situation Monitor to the workstation allows more coordination over enemy vessel movements.
utility_aux_operation_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

We are able to create a new supplement to our operations station, that allows us to add information directly into the line of sight of the operations team officer, enabling full 360 degree view of the ship. This drastically increases the officer's ability to track ship status at the station.
utility_aux_repair_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

A manned centralised station where damage control teams can be organised and dispatched from, routing them to the most severely damaged and important systems and improving the repair rate of the vessel.
utility_aux_repair_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

Prioritisation, via the Master Situation Monitor, allows for repair teams to be automatically dispatched to the nearest damaged high priority sectors, improving the efficiency of vessel repairs.
utility_aux_repair_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

A full holographic display detailing the damaged sections of the vessel and automatically dispatching repair teams, whilst replicating damaged components that require repair, further improving the efficiency of vessel repairs.
utility_aux_tellarite_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

Strong forcefield technology ensures the integrity of Tellarite vessels when arguments break out.
utility_aux_vulcan_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

Gravimetric logic banks cross check and discard illogical data sets allowing for improved sensor output.
utility_large_afterburner_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

An archaic engine design, retooled to act as a supplement to the main engine. A high energy density, solid-state fuel source is burnt at a high temperature, producing a hot gas. Under pressure, the gas is vented out of a nozzle facing the rear of the ship. The expansion of the gas as it leaves the ship provides us with some forward thrust.
utility_large_afterburner_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

A modernised chemical fuel afterburner which uses a powerful new liquid fuel, Gronerium. The Gronerium's storage tanks are subjected to a gravitational gradient, ensuring that the fuel is always at the intake end of the tank. In the event that the graviton field is shut down, a solid fuel pod located above the tank can be ignited, pushing a plate down onto the Gronerium, forcing it into the intake valve.
utility_large_afterburner_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

An off-shot of inertial dampener technology, impulse afterburners store the inertial forces of accelerating and decelerating, instead of dissipating them. The stored force can be converted into a form of thrust, giving the ship a speed boost.
utility_large_afterburner_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

The third version of the Fusion Intermix Booster afterburner, first version that doesn't explode after a short time. Uses a fusion reactor to produce high energy plasma, similar to an old impulse engine. Shortly before the plasma is expelled, it's infused with a small amount of antimatter. The antimatter annihilation raises the temperature to 47keV, providing significant supplementary thrust.
utility_large_borg_lab_1_DESC: Several layers of data nodes dedicated to sifting through information obtained by this ship of the collective.
utility_large_borg_tracking_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

The central plexus links each Borg vessel to every other Borg vessel. This facilitates the fast and efficient transfer of the Collective's knowledge, and real time tactical data. It also allows each vessel's computer to offload processing tasks to other vessels during times of high demand.
utility_large_borg_tracking_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

Updated computer cores which are able to interface with all nanoprobes present on the vessel. The nanoprobes take over performing simple calculations, allowing the computer core's advanced processing units to handle difficult computations.
utility_large_borg_tracking_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

More advanced calculations are now performed by the interlink node, which interfaces with all nanites and nanoprobes on the vessel.
utility_large_borg_tracking_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

A central interlink node is similar to a central processing node on the Unimatrix. It is capable of vast amounts of processing and calculations, as well as handling more complex subroutines.
utility_large_casino_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

High rollers from many worlds enjoy visits to these luxurious mobile casinos that traverse the stars, away from any prying eyes.

Mobile Casinos produce a small amount of £ latinum; and remember: the House always wins.
utility_large_damper_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Basic anti-gravity technology used to counteract the effects of high-velocity spaceflight.
utility_large_damper_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Distributed anti-gravity and ballast systems, that enable the free movement and support of crew and materials.
utility_large_damper_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

Powered by the Higgs Field itself, this inertial damper ensures the ship is protected by the effects of super luminal spaceflight.
utility_large_damper_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Trans-luminal space flight affecting the space-time continuum can now be adjusted via chroniton based temporal adjustment dampers.
utility_large_deflector_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

A secondary navigational deflector is added to the main hull, allowing additional protection from navigational hazards and debris.
utility_large_deflector_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

The power of the secondary navigational deflector is enhanced by faster than light tachyons which allows more power to flow through.
utility_large_deflector_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

The subspace barriers can be pushed to one side by an interplexing navigational deflector, allowing smooth transit at high speeds.
utility_large_lab_engineering_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

This specialised laboratory is equipped with advanced sensor arrays and adaptable processing cores, which allow for immediate, on-site analysis of anomalies and rapid prototyping of technological breakthroughs.

Technology Lab modules produce £ Engineering Research for your empire.
utility_large_lab_engineering_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

This upgraded laboratory features hyper-tuned optical arrays and adaptive quantum processors. It's designed to not just analyse, but to synthesise new insights from raw data, boosting research efficiency.

Technology Lab modules produce £ Engineering Research for your empire.
utility_large_lab_engineering_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

This technology lab integrates bleeding-edge multi-spectral arrays and sentient analytical processors, capable of not just observing, but actively interacting with and manipulating reality on a sub-quantum level.

Technology Lab modules produce £ Engineering Research for your empire.
utility_large_lab_physics_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

An additional onboard physics laboratory, outfitted with detectors for charged particles, phase discriminators, pulse height analysers, and spectral analysis.

Physics Lab modules produce £ Physics Research for your empire.
utility_large_lab_physics_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

An onboard physics scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse space-time on a galactic scale.

Physics Lab modules produce £ Physics Research for your empire.
utility_large_lab_physics_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

An onboard physics scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse space-time on a galactic scale.

Physics Lab modules produce £ Physics Research for your empire.
utility_large_lab_society_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

An additional onboard biology laboratory, outfitted with detectors for DNA, lifeforms, pulse height analysers, and biogenic analysis.

Biology Lab modules produce £ Society Research for your empire.
utility_large_lab_society_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

An onboard biological scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse real-time retroviral DNA on a large scale.

Biology Lab modules produce £ Society Research for your empire.
utility_large_lab_society_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

An onboard biological scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse real-time retroviral DNA on a large scale.

Biology Lab modules produce £ Society Research for your empire.
utility_large_labs_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

An additional basic mobile science lab, designed to deal with a variety of spatial phenomena encountered in deep space.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
utility_large_labs_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Scientific facility with added nuclear research capabilities, including detectors for charged particles, phase discriminators, pulse height analysers and spectral analysis.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
utility_large_labs_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Scientific facility with a focus on charting stars and planets. Real time sensor arrays provide detail on nearby stars, planets, nebulae, and other stellar bodies, allowing ships to investigate anomalies with increased success.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
utility_large_labs_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Scientific facility with the ability to comprehensively analyse space-time on a galactic scale. Large holographic displays can render entire sectors in real time.

Lab modules may only be placed on dedicated £ Science ships.
utility_large_science_station_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Our advancements in sensor technology have given us the ability to create a new workstation for our science officers. This will provide us with the data to better evade enemy ships, but also help track an enemy ship's movement and, most importantly, improve the sensor locking for our weapons on enemy ships.
utility_large_science_station_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

A state-of-the-art science centre with holographic technology allows a 360 degree field of view, and the passing of important information to bridge stations almost instantaneously.
utility_large_stealth_hull_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

By introducing darker materials within the external layers of a ship's hull we can make our ship's harder to track by enemy sensors.
utility_large_stealth_hull_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

While this material is more refractive than most it has been engineered to refract active sensor beams, thus reducing the amount it returns to sensors. While this will lead to further increase in our evasion it comes at a further cost of our molecular structure of the ship's hull.
utility_large_stealth_hull_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

By masking adaptive circuitry into our ship's hull it will increase our evasion of enemy sensors at a level we haven't seen before, however, due the sophisticated nature of the technology used in this material it will come at an even greater cost of our ship's molecular structure.
utility_large_tracking_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

By utilising the intrinsic spin of the electron, this solid state computer core can be dedicated to targeting solutions, increasing its accuracy.
utility_large_tracking_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

By erecting a system of ODN relays across the ship, it is possible to connect this remote secondary computer core to the main mainframe with almost zero loss due to lag and with a significantly increased computational power. This greatly benefits the ship during combat, increasing its accuracy.
utility_large_tracking_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

By linking numerous multitronic cores together in the computer core, this core can take over tasks that would otherwise be too demanding on the mainframe. This greatly benefits the ship during high load events, such as combat.
utility_large_tracking_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

With advances in positronics, attaching this secondary core to the mainframe gives a hint of self awareness and consciousness to the core. Prioritisation of tasks can be done automatically, vastly increasing the effectiveness of the ship during crisis events such as combat.
utility_large_tracking_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Cetacean Ops was a facility aboard Starfleet starships in the late 24th century. They generally contained an aquarium, so as to simulate the natural habitat of cetaceans allowing them to work on navigation and sensor operations.
utility_large_undine_tracking_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

The Telepathic Tracing Node tracks psionic echoes across fluidic space. Engineered by the Undine to monitor intrusions and rogue minds, it amplifies collective telepathic awareness, reinforcing unity while enforcing purity against mental corruption or alien influence.
utility_large_undine_tracking_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Enhanced by quantum-biopsionic arrays, this upgraded Undine device extends psi-range across dimensions. It isolates corrupted consciousness, decodes alien thought signatures, and deepens unity within the collective mind—ensuring absolute psychic vigilance across fluidic and infiltrated galactic zones.
utility_large_undine_tracking_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

Forged with tri-phase neurogenic cores, this node penetrates multi-temporal consciousness. It safeguards fluidic space by predicting telepathic incursions, enforcing Undine mental cohesion, and erasing foreign influences before they destabilize the Collective’s psychic harmony across dimensional frontiers.
utility_medium_borg_eps_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

High energy plasma is safely routed from the warp reactor to the drive engines.
utility_medium_borg_eps_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Warp reactor plasma is additionally distributed throughout the ship as a direct energy supply.
utility_medium_borg_eps_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

The warp reactor and impulse drive systems are looped together. This provides an additional source of plasma energy for systems use.
utility_medium_borg_eps_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

With the EPS matrix linked to every system tying them directly in to warp power, systems around the ship gain additional power.
utility_medium_borg_eps_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

With the EPS relay infused with warp plasma, systems around the ship gain additional power.
utility_medium_disruptor_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

The sonic disruptor field vibrates the molecules within an enemy vessels armour, allowing for improved damage.
utility_medium_disruptor_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

The molecular disruption field can further destabilize the armoured layers around a starship, further increasing damage.
utility_medium_disruptor_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Breaking the atomic bonds within a starships armour allows for increased damage.
utility_medium_disruptor_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Tearing apart a starship at the subatomic level drastically reduces the effectiveness of enemy armour.
utility_medium_eps_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

High energy plasma is safely routed from the warp reactor to the drive engines.
utility_medium_eps_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Warp reactor plasma is additionally distributed throughout the ship as a direct energy supply.
utility_medium_eps_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

The warp reactor and impulse drive systems are looped together. This provides an additional source of plasma energy for systems use.
utility_medium_eps_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

With the EPS matrix linked to every system tying them directly in to warp power, systems around the ship gain additional power.
utility_medium_eps_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

With the EPS relay infused with warp plasma, systems around the ship gain additional power.
utility_medium_plasmadyne_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

A secondary plasmadyne relay disperses the plasma of the blast across a large area, draining enemy shields.
utility_medium_plasmadyne_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

By amping up the plasmadyne relay we can ensure that the blasts spread across enemy shielding, draining them substantially.
utility_medium_plasmadyne_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Utilising quantum tunneling, our weapons can penetrate and spread across the numerous layers of shielding of an enemy vessel.
utility_medium_plasmadyne_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

By spreading the damage over numerous polarities we can amplify the blast damage to enemy shields.
utility_medium_scatter_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Spreading the damage over a large area of hull can cause massive hull breaches on enemy vessels.
utility_medium_scatter_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

Spreading the damage over a large area of hull can cause massive hull breaches on enemy vessels.
utility_medium_scatter_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Spreading the damage over a large area of hull can cause massive hull breaches on enemy vessels.
utility_medium_scatter_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Spreading the damage over a large area of hull can cause massive hull breaches on enemy vessels.
utility_medium_tactical_station_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

With the continued use of combat oriented workstations we have studied what our tactical officers find useful and what they find distracting. As a result our computer scientists have come up with a more streamlined interface to this workstation, that better suits a tactical officers need in the heat of combat.
utility_medium_tactical_station_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

A secondary tactical node allows for secondary tasks such as command and control, or tactical system scanning to be achieved without reducing the effectiveness of the primary consoles.
utility_medium_tactical_station_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Laying out the bridge to ensure a rapid free flow of information on all tactical stations improves combat effectiveness of a vessel drastically.
utility_reactor_1_DESC: Basic nuclear power. Control rods moderate a Uranium pile to generate nuclear energy.
utility_reactor_2_DESC: Experimentation with magnetic coils and lasers has yielded the ability to reproduce the energy process found within stars.
utility_reactor_3_DESC: Helium-4 nuclear fusion reactor with a carbon-oxygen byproduct.
utility_reactor_4_DESC: Improvements in magnetic containment and laser ignition have resulted in better fusion reactions.
utility_reactor_5_DESC: Miniaturised fusion reactors are assembled together to provide maximum fuel economy, part redundancy and increased power output.
utility_reactor_6_DESC: Carefully shielded device that harnesses thermionic radiation.
utility_reactor_7_DESC: A miniature space-time rift is used to create a radiation source. Hardware adapted from thermionic and fission control systems is used to absorb this radiation for generating power.
utility_reactor_8_DESC: Utilising the rare but powerful refined Decalithium crystal residue to generate high levels of power.
utility_reactor_9_DESC: A temporal core, which kept the vessel out of phase with normal spacetime, thereby protecting it from the changes to the timeline which it initiated.
utility_reactor_pergium_DESC: Pergium is blended with other radioactive compounds to create an enhanced fission reactor. It's not as clean as fusion, but it increases the availability of radioactive fuel sources in general.
utility_reactor_solar_DESC: A unique design created by the Kessok, absorbing the energy from nearby stars and converting it into a huge amount of energy.
utility_reactor_thalaron_DESC: A thalaron reactor is a device designed to harness thalaron radiation safely in order to produce large amounts of power. If not kept stable, it can emit a cascading biogenic pulse with which to destroy all organic matter.
utility_reactor_undine_1_DESC: Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production.
utility_reactor_undine_2_DESC: Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production. This energy is then amplified using the psychic power of the Undine mind.
utility_reactor_undine_3_DESC: Specially mixed concentrations of fluidic matter and bio-matter generates powerful waves of energy that can be used to power Undine Technology.
utility_reactor_undine_fluidic_DESC: Mass detonation of biomass is harnest by the powerful minds of Undine engineers and directed towards powering their most powerful vessels.
utility_small_armor_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

Adding external layers of support to the hull greatly reinforces its durability.
utility_small_armor_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Standardised armour designs allow rapid modifications to the armour level of a vessel.
utility_small_armor_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Trellium plating is used to line the hull, providing increased protection from the dangers of space.
utility_small_armor_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Heavier trellium plating secures the hull, providing substantial protection from the dangers of deep space.
utility_small_armor_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

An armor designed to disintegrate at a controlled rate under directed energy blasts, providing an additional layer of defense for a spaceship's hull.
utility_small_armor_6_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

By having a type of material that's reflective, we gain the ability to absorb energy. We can put this type of material to use within our armour plating design branches, offering even more protection against weapon fire at a spaceship's hull.
utility_small_auto_facility_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Advances in AI and automation processes combined with the advanced operations of a starship allow for increased efficiency across the ship.
utility_small_borg_armor_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

Additional layers of living metal hull plating positioned under the primary hull. While these layers are no more durable than the primary layer, they prevent weapons from penetrating as far into the vessel as they otherwise would.
utility_small_borg_armor_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Living armour which has been upgraded with the ability to change its composition during combat. This allows it to dynamically adapt to the weapons that it's protecting against.
utility_small_borg_armor_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Several layers of parametallic plating form a durable barrier to protect the vessel's hull. Autonomous regeneration nodes repair the armour during battle.
utility_small_borg_armor_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

Advanced regenerative armour generated by a network of self replicating, autonomous regeneration units.
utility_small_borg_armor_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Superior regenerative armour generated by a network of self replicating, autonomous regeneration units. Capable of regenerating after being completely destroyed, it provides massive protection against most forms of weaponry.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

Force fields that adapt to the damage onboard a Borg vessel, sealing off damaged areas.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

The integrity field that can snap into place and ensure that the vessel can hold together under massive stress even when it's materials are failing.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

Updated structural integrity field subsystem. New adaptation algorithms control a modular and highly reconfigurable field generator network. This network reinforces damaged sections, holding the vessel together longer.
utility_small_borg_forcefield_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

An adaptive structural integrity field subsystem which utilises a layered field network. This configuration provides stronger reinforcement to damage sections, further increasing the vessels operational parameters.
utility_small_borg_starbase_generator_1_:
Technology Level: 6

A simple subspace field envelops the station, providing a measure of protection from weaponry.
utility_small_chapel_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

The floating chapels allow for religious ceremonies to be carried out amongst the crew, improving the overall feeling of unity amongst the stars.

Vessels that have this module equipped will occasionally generate a small amount of £ unity as they traverse the galaxy.
utility_small_engineering_station_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

Although most engineering functions are controlled from the engine room, engineering stations on the bridge of starships enable monitoring and control by the chief engineer
utility_small_engineering_station_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Engineering station that provides real time performance and metrics of all ships systems and the touch of a button.
utility_small_engineering_station_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

A perfected engineering station that allows engineers complete control of a ships functions whilst being in the thick of the action without needing to be in engineering.
utility_small_engineering_station_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

A large holographic display allows for 360 degree control over all items at this workstation.
utility_small_forcefield_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

In the event of an outer hull breach, emergency force fields are automatically deployed to protect the damaged area from the influences of space. The force fields work in conjunction with existing, physical bulkheads, greatly increasing the resilience of the spaceship. Force fields especially benefit larger ships - the bigger the hull, the larger the effect.
utility_small_forcefield_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

Improved force fields that can snap into place around any breach or person to secure them briefly against the vast darkness of empty space.
utility_small_forcefield_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

Our engineers were able to improve upon our force field technology so that it supports the bulkheads of a spaceship's shape. By doing this, our spaceship's will be even more capable of enduring the harsh elements and forces of interstellar travel.
utility_small_forcefield_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

Our engineers were able to use a structural integrity force field, that supplements the supports and bulkheads of a spaceship's shape. By doing this, our spaceship's will be even more capable of enduring the harsh elements and forces of interstellar travel.
utility_small_forcefield_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

Advanced force field generators and dispersion arrays added to our structural integrity field make spaceships even more capable of enduring the extreme elements and forces of interstellar travel.
utility_small_forcefield_6_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

An ever shifting structural integrity field that can be adjusted to provide additional reinforcement to sections under undue stress.
utility_small_forcefield_7_DESC:
Technology Level: 10

A shielding forcefield that is fluxating in time creating a powerful field against conventional weapons.
utility_small_generator_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Besides shield emitters we can also find another use for the process of storing a large field of gravitons. This gives us the ability to create a utility device that increases the strength of our shields.
utility_small_generator_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

By surrounding a ship in multiple graviton layers we can upgrade our current field generators to be modulated against specific frequency ranges of particle beams and radiation.
utility_small_generator_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

By carefully modulating the phase of the gravitons emitted, the multiple layers of older field generators have been compressed into a single layer providing an immediate boost to our shields.
utility_small_generator_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

By modulating the hyper phasic fields nearby, the layers of shielding around our ship can be increased providing a boost to the strength of our shields.
utility_small_generator_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

Chromodynamic shields use gravitons which can be modulated to be more effective against a greater spectrum of radiation.
utility_small_hard_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

By creating a force field inside our ship we are able to seal hull breaches and absorb structural stress from incoming fire and in doing so it increases the durability of our ship's hull.
utility_small_hard_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

Introducing new changes to our shield emitters has caused our force fields to have reduced response times in reinforcing a ship's hull.
utility_small_hard_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 6

By introducing multiple configurations to our force fields we are able to better adapt to the incoming damage that the ship's hull would be taking on.
utility_small_hard_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

By studying the effects of how our shield emitters convert minor feedback into the matrix we were able to observe how this mechanical energy was absorbed into a ship's hull. In doing, we believe we have come up with improvements to our force field technology that further reinforce the armor of a ship's hull.
utility_small_hard_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 8

By utilising spatial shield refractors we are able to observe how energy and impacts affect the hull, which further reinforces hull integrity.
utility_small_prison_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 4

An orbital prison acts as a floating brig, where punishments can be meted out and the crew returned to service, once the sentence is complete.

Vessels that have this module equipped will occasionally generate a small amount of £ crew as they traverse the galaxy.
utility_small_prospecting_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

A prospecting bay allows for the processing of any small rare asteroids that the construction vessel may come across, refining it into minerals.

Construction ships that have this module equipped will occasionally generate a small amount of £ minerals as they traverse the galaxy.
utility_small_starbase_generator_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 5

A large shield generator designed to cover the large large surface area of a starbase.
utility_small_starbase_generator_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 9

An improved shield generator designed for starbases, which a constantly rotating frequency which increases energy requirements but also substantially increases protection.
utility_small_undine_armor_1_DESC:
Technology Level: 0

This plating is a form of biomechanical armor, cultivated in specialised Undine maturation facilities. It actively adapts to incoming threats in real time and seamlessly integrates with the ship's systems. This plating resists diverse attack vectors and deploys countermeasures, significantly boosting the vessel's resilience.
utility_small_undine_armor_2_DESC:
Technology Level: 1

This hull is designed to constantly recalibrate its molecular structure in order to counter energy and kinetic threats. Drawing on the Undine Hivemind, it develops resistances during combat, integrates seamlessly with the ship's control systems and maintains the vessel's operational effectiveness in fluctuating tactical and environmental conditions.
utility_small_undine_armor_3_DESC:
Technology Level: 2

We have developed a sophisticated form of bio-adaptive hull plating that stores and recalls defensive configurations. Every time the armour is exposed to a new attack, it analyses the threat, records its properties and instantly adapts its molecular structure to counter it. This learned resistance is then integrated into the Undine Hivemind, enabling other vessels to instantly access and utilise optimal defensive patterns.
utility_small_undine_armor_4_DESC:
Technology Level: 3

A learning armour is an advanced, evolving hull system. It processes tactical data in real time, observing and analysing every incoming threat. It doesn't just adapt, it proactively learns the unique properties and vectors of attacks. This knowledge is applied immediately, recalibrating the armour's composition and energy absorption properties in real time.
utility_small_undine_armor_5_DESC:
Technology Level: 7

This highly responsive hull system operates with a heightened sense of its environment. It doesn't just react to impacts; it anticipates them. By constantly processing subtle shifts in energy signatures, localised gravimetric distortions and even minute changes in the immediate tactical field, the armour pre-emptively adjusts its defensive properties. This enables it to recalibrate its molecular structure and energy dampening fields almost instantly before a direct hit.
utility_small_undine_regen_1_DESC: Equipping our ships with adaptive regeneration technology, which innates the restorative power of our unique physiology, we enable them to rapidly repair and reinforce their defences.
utility_small_undine_regen_2_DESC: By harnessing our innate regenerative abilities, ships can rapidly restore damaged systems and crew efficiency, minimising downtime during intense battles or extended missions.
utility_small_undine_regen_3_DESC: Through superior biomatter manipulation, we achieve accelerated healing of critical wounds to our ships, enhancing the overall effectiveness and longevity of our fleet, even in the face of overwhelming adversity.
utility_temporal_lab_DESC: Temporal research lab that helps us identify anomalies in the timeline.
utility_undine_tactical_1_DESC: Our ships are impervious to the unclean.
utility_undine_tactical_2_DESC: Our ships are impervious to the unclean.
utility_undine_tactical_3_DESC: Our ships are impervious to the unclean.
